books.title: La Scienza in Cucina e l'Arte di Mangiar Bene
books.subtitle: Manuale completo per le famiglie italiane
books.author: Pellegrino Artusi
books.description: The most famous Italian cookbook, Artusi compiled recipes from across Italy after his retirement. Though published privately after rejections from publishers, it became the de facto Italian cookbook.

books.title: Manuale di Cucina
books.author: Paola Dalla Verde
books.description: An early 20th century manual focusing on Northern Italian cuisine, with emphasis on rice dishes and butter-based sauces typical of the region.

books.title: Cucina Teorica Pratica
books.subtitle: Opera diviso in due parti
books.author: Ippolito Cavalcanti
books.description: One of the earliest systematic Italian cookbooks, combining French technique with Neapolitan tradition. Famous for introducing the 'cucina povera' philosophy.

books.title: Italian Cooking
books.subtitle: A Collection of Italian Recipes
books.author: Edna Grabhorn
books.description: An American perspective on Italian cooking, documenting how Italian recipes were adapted in the United States during the mid-century immigration period.

books.title: La Cucina Francese e Italiana
books.subtitle: Opera utile alle famiglie
books.author: Francesco Leonardi & Giuseppe Liguori
books.description: A comparative study of French and Italian cooking techniques, reflecting the Napoleonic era's cultural exchange between the two cuisines.

books.title: La Cucina Milanese
books.subtitle: Ricette tradizionali della cucina Lombarda
books.author: Massimo Alberini
books.description: A regional cookbook dedicated to Milanese and Lombard cuisine, featuring risotto, ossobuco, and other northern Italian specialties.

books.title: La Cucina Napoletana
books.subtitle: Cento ricette classiche
books.author: Lina Vitelli
books.description: A focused collection of 100 classic Neapolitan recipes, documenting the essential dishes of one of Italy's most celebrated culinary traditions.

metadata.note: This is sample data for V1 prototype. All books are public domain verified.
